_doc: Balance numbers (P1-06, doc 04). Read through scripts/domain/balance.gd (Balance.num('section.key')); tools/validate_data.py checks every key, type and range. Chances are 0-1; percent points are 0-100. Other tuning lives next to its system: statuses.json (status durations, caps), progression.json (XP, difficulty, skill ranks), camp_skills.json, town_events.json, items.json (prices), region JSONs (map generator, light).

combat._doc: Hit = hit_base + (accuracy + skill accuracy - dodge) * hit_per_point, clamped hit_min..hit_max. Crit chance capped at crit_cap; crits deal x crit_mult. Protection is capped at prot_cap %. Guard: physical damage x guard_mult. A hero who misses gains miss_stress; a crit leaves them Encarrerado for encarrerado_turns. Enemies without 'crit' in enemies.json use enemy_base_crit.

crits._doc: Doc 01 §2.3 stress shock (owner 2026-11-11, Darkest Dungeon style): a hero's crit relieves party_relief stress for every living hero; an enemy crit adds enemy_crit_stress to the hero hit.

death._doc: Doc 01 §2.4 Al Borde death roll: base = default 'golpe_de_gracia' % (heroes.json may set their own); minus check_penalty per earlier roll this expedition; minus the highest stress_penalties entry [stress, points] that applies; minus collapse_penalty on a Colapso (doc 01 §3.4). The cap is statuses.json deathblow_cap.

stress._doc: Doc 01 §3: resolve check at resolve_threshold (Quebranto with quebranto_chance, else Virtud, which resets stress to virtud_reset); Colapso at colapso (also the stress cap); surviving a Colapso while Al Borde leaves colapso_survive. Hero stress_resist is clamped to stress_resist_min..stress_resist_max; status resistances to status_resist_cap.

afflictions._doc: Quebranto / Virtud behaviour (doc 01 §3.3; stat changes are statuses.json mental_mods). Chances 0-1.

enemies._doc: Room squads: the leader gets boss_hp_mult (boss rooms) or elite_hp_mult (elite rooms); everyone else's HP is scaled by squad_hp_scale[squad size] (index 0-4).

hub._doc: Hacienda prices (item prices are in items.json). The Pulpería buys back at sell_rate of the price (owner rule). EBAIS: heal_cost_per_hp per missing PV, at least heal_min_cost. Iglesia misa: iglesia_cost, relieves iglesia_relief stress; with iglesia_backfire_chance a hero gets iglesia_backfire_stress instead.

limits._doc: Owner 2026-11-12: tunable limits. The party size (4) stays in code: the stage, positions 1-4 and the hub are built around it.

hunger._doc: Travel hunger (P1-18, DD hunger checks). Every every_moves moves the party stops to eat: 1 gallo pinto per living hero. A hero who doesn't eat loses hp_pct of max PV (never below 1) and gains stress. A camp meal resets the count.

light._doc: Torch light (Luz) ranges 0..max (P1-17, DD torch). tiers: brightest first; a tier applies from its min up to the next one. Per tier: enemy_dmg_pct and enemy_crit (added to enemy attacks), stress_pct (stress heroes take in combat), loot_pct (colones from fights and curios), party_surprised_pct / enemies_surprised_pct (chance a normal fight opens with that side acting first), trap_pct (added to the disarm chance), move_stress and move_stress_all (stress per move to one random hero, or to everyone), low (counts as low light for the camp ambush). snuff: Luz lost when the player puts out the candle. Rules: scripts/domain/light_system.gd.
